tooltips.productSelect: Choose the product code whose control limit versions you want to view or edit.

tooltips.exportData: Export the current browser demo data as JSON for backup or transfer.
tooltips.importData: Import previously exported demo JSON into this browser's local demo storage.
tooltips.openSaveFile: Open a portable JSON save file and use it as the product/version database without running the local server.
tooltips.newSaveFile: Create a new portable JSON save file. In supported browsers you can choose where it is saved.
tooltips.saveNow: Write the current products, versions, and tooltip text to the selected save file.
tooltips.downloadSaveCopy: Download the current database as a JSON save file copy for transfer or backup.
tooltips.editTooltips: Edit help text shown when users hover over controls. SQLite Mode can write edits back into this HTML file.
tooltips.effectiveDate: The date when this control limit version starts to apply.
tooltips.revisionNo: The revision number shown in the version history.
tooltips.versionType: Permanent versions stay active until replaced. Deviation Request (DR) versions require an end date.
tooltips.endDate: Required for DR versions; this is the last date the deviation request applies.
tooltips.plantLineScope: Select the plants and production lines that this control limit version applies to.
tooltips.processLimits: Edit the process, parameter/unit, minimum, and maximum limits. Section rows can group related parameters.
tooltips.viewVersion: Open a read-only view of this saved version.
tooltips.deleteVersion: Delete this version from the active storage mode.
